label: Schedule
description: A trigger fired by the clock: a five-field cron expression in a timezone, or an interval whose ticks are the multiples of it since the Unix epoch. The schedule runs only while a project's startup list names `@schedule/scheduler.port.json#run`, so a tree that names none schedules nothing, as a tree that names no listener serves nothing. The tick's instant reaches the graph as an input, so nothing in the tree calls a clock and a rehearsal replays a tick like any request. On several instances the `run` step names a `lease`: a connection whose kind declares `leases`, on which one instance takes the tick.

timezone.description: the IANA zone a cron trigger is read in when it names none; absent: UTC

leaseTtlMs.description: how long a hold taken for a tick lasts without renewal, so a process that dies mid-run lets go of the tick; a whole number of 1000 or more, default 30000
